name: im-payroll-social
description: Use this skill for Isle of Man payroll and National Insurance in the 2026/27 tax year (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027). It covers who pays which class, the 2026/27 Class 1 thresholds (primary and secondary threshold GBP 176 a week, upper earnings limit GBP 1,082), the 11% and 1% employee rates and the 12.8% employer rate with no upper limit, directors' annual earnings period, Class 2 (GBP 6.75 a week) and the small earnings exception, Class 3, Class 4 (8% and 1%), ITIP income tax deductions and tax codes, employer registration and monthly T35 payments by the 19th, the annual return by 5 May, employer penalties, the UK reciprocal agreement and detached workers. Trigger on: Isle of Man payroll, Manx National Insurance, ITIP, T35, employer NI Isle of Man, Class 4 IOM. Out of scope: income tax on the employee's annual assessment (im-income-tax), non-residents (im-non-resident-income-tax), companies (im-corporate-income-tax), VAT (isle-of-man-vat).
